value.heading: GENERAL INFORMATION
value.text: The Company is incorporated in the Republic of Singapore. The principal activities of the Company are those of general trading.

value.heading: BASIS OF PREPARATION AND SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES
value.text: The financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the historical cost convention, except as disclosed in the accounting policies below, and are drawn up in accordance with the provisions of the Singapore Financial Reporting Standards for Small Entities (SFRS for Small Entities).

value.heading: REVENUE
value.text: Revenue represents the invoiced value of goods sold, net of goods and services tax and trade discounts.

value.heading: OTHER INCOME
value.text: Other income comprises interest income and sundry income.

value.heading: STAFF COSTS
value.text: Staff costs include salaries, bonuses, and the Company's contributions to the Central Provident Fund on behalf of employees.

value.heading: PROPERTY, PLANT AND EQUIPMENT
value.text: Property, plant and equipment comprise office equipment, furniture and fittings, renovation, and motor vehicles used in the Company's trading operations, stated at cost less accumulated depreciation and accumulated impairment losses. Depreciation is computed on a straight-line basis over the estimated useful lives of the assets.

value.heading: FINANCE COSTS
value.text: Finance costs comprise interest expense on bank borrowings and finance lease liabilities.

value.heading: TAX EXPENSE
value.text: Tax expense represents the estimated Singapore corporate income tax payable, computed at the prevailing statutory tax rate on the Company's chargeable income for the year.

value.heading: INTANGIBLE ASSETS
value.text: Intangible assets comprise computer software licences, amortised on a straight-line basis over their estimated useful lives.

value.heading: INVENTORIES
value.text: Inventories are stated at the lower of cost and net realisable value. Cost is determined on a first-in-first-out basis.

value.heading: TRADE RECEIVABLES
value.text: Trade receivables are amounts due from customers in the ordinary course of business, stated net of allowance for expected credit losses.

value.heading: CASH AND BANK BALANCES
value.text: Cash and bank balances comprise cash on hand and balances with banks, including the Company's operating accounts used for day-to-day transactions.

value.heading: BANK BORROWINGS
value.text: Bank borrowings comprise a term loan facility, secured against the Company's property, plant and equipment, repayable in monthly instalments over the facility tenure.

value.heading: SHARE CAPITAL
value.text: Share capital comprises fully paid ordinary shares, with no par value, issued by the Company.

accounting_standard.value: Singapore Financial Reporting Standards for Small Entities (SFRS for Small Entities)

value.heading: GENERAL INFORMATION
value.text: The Company is incorporated in the Republic of Singapore. The principal activities of the Company are those of general trading.

value.heading: BASIS OF PREPARATION AND SIGNIFICANT ACCOUNTING POLICIES
value.text: The financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the historical cost convention, except as disclosed in the accounting policies below, and are drawn up in accordance with the provisions of the Singapore Financial Reporting Standards for Small Entities (SFRS for Small Entities).

value.heading: REVENUE
value.text: Revenue represents the invoiced value of goods sold, net of goods and services tax and trade discounts.

value.heading: OTHER INCOME
value.text: Other income comprises interest income and sundry income.

value.heading: STAFF COSTS
value.text: Staff costs include salaries, bonuses, and the Company's contributions to the Central Provident Fund on behalf of employees.

value.heading: PROPERTY, PLANT AND EQUIPMENT
value.text: Property, plant and equipment comprise office equipment, furniture and fittings, renovation, and motor vehicles used in the Company's trading operations, stated at cost less accumulated depreciation and accumulated impairment losses. Depreciation is computed on a straight-line basis over the estimated useful lives of the assets.

value.heading: FINANCE COSTS
value.text: Finance costs comprise interest expense on bank borrowings and finance lease liabilities.

value.heading: TAX EXPENSE
value.text: Tax expense represents the estimated Singapore corporate income tax payable, computed at the prevailing statutory tax rate on the Company's chargeable income for the year.

value.heading: INTANGIBLE ASSETS
value.text: Intangible assets comprise computer software licences, amortised on a straight-line basis over their estimated useful lives.

value.heading: INVENTORIES
value.text: Inventories are stated at the lower of cost and net realisable value. Cost is determined on a first-in-first-out basis.

value.heading: TRADE RECEIVABLES
value.text: Trade receivables are amounts due from customers in the ordinary course of business, stated net of allowance for expected credit losses.

value.heading: CASH AND BANK BALANCES
value.text: Cash and bank balances comprise cash on hand and balances with banks, including the Company's operating accounts used for day-to-day transactions.

value.heading: BANK BORROWINGS
value.text: Bank borrowings comprise a term loan facility, secured against the Company's property, plant and equipment, repayable in monthly instalments over the facility tenure.

value.heading: SHARE CAPITAL
value.text: Share capital comprises fully paid ordinary shares, with no par value, issued by the Company.
